results.content:
Oktoberfest is coming to the zoo—because beer gardens have always needed more giraffes. The brand-new Zootoberfest takes over the L.A. Zoo September 19 and 20 with German-inspired food, giant pretzels, specialty beers, root beer floats, live Oktoberfest bands, lawn games, a braid bar, themed photo ops and plenty of fall vibes. Admission to the family-friendly celebration is included with your general admission zoo ticket. Food and drinks are available for purchase, so come for the animals, stay [...] Forget the usual museum stroll—let’s dance! LACMA is celebrating the Mid-Autumn Festival with a traditional lion dance accompanied by live music from the Immortals Lion Dance crew. The free performance takes place Sunday, September 20, at the David Geffen Galleries’ Plaza Level, as part of the museum’s free Third Weekends program and in celebration of its exhibition “Fashioning Chinese Women.” No ticket required: Just show up and prepare to make your museum visit a considerably livelier one.
